tools.name: get_whale_trades
tools.description: Polymarket whale trades: the largest recent buys and sells across all markets above a size you choose, with trader name, outcome, price and USD size. 5- and 15-minute crypto markets filtered out. Pair with /v1/wallet to check whether a whale is any good.

tools.name: get_skilled_whale_trades

tools.name: find_market_disagreements
tools.description: Polymarket markets where smart money disagrees with the odds: scans the 30 busiest open markets every 15 minutes and returns those where skilled traders' money implies a different probability than the price, tempered against thin evidence, with a low, medium or high confidence rating. tools.name: detect_drug_safety_signals

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_drug_approvals · Private data: get_whale_trades, get_wallet_scorecard, get_airport_status, list_flight_disruptions · Public sink: get_drug_safety.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_drug_approvals · Private data: get_whale_trades, get_wallet_scorecard, get_airport_status, list_flight_disruptions · Public sink: get_drug_safety

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
